# Cncf Hadoop Hdfs Reviewer

Review Hadoop HDFS using its official documentation and repository in the Data / Data Architecture category. Open source framework works by rapidly transferring data between nodes. It&#39;s often used by companies who need to handle and store big data.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
